data-id="content-viewer"><div class="unp46"><div class="tzeth"><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="atf0a" id="viewer-atf0a" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>We&#x27;ve noticed a lot of busy students and riders struggling to consistently get out and achieve their desired ability. This tour was designed to get the maximum amount of progression in the fastest way possible.</span><span>
</span><span>
</span><span> If you&#x27;ve never touched a kite before our kitesurfing tours give you the best chance to be riding by the end of the week. If you&#x27;re starting to ride consistently you will end up jumping or riding waves. If you&#x27;re starting to jump you will be spinning and looping in no time. </span><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>The beach is on your doorstep. The Trade Wind picks up later in the morning which gives you a chance to rest, snorkel, spearfish, surf or foil. If foiling has taken your fancy you will have an abundance of opportunity to learn. As well as a kite school we are also a foil school and can offer daily tow foiling lessons with professional instructors depending on tide and wind conditions.</span><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>The ultimate learning method for kiting is downwinders. Starting at one point and riding along the coast to be picked up further downwind. This removes the hardest and most time consuming part of kitesurfing: going upwind, and allows you the maximum amount of time to spend working on your goals. To ensure your safety, a boat will follow you along the coast with instructors coaching you along the way.</span><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>GoPro, drone and camera footage will be taken of you along the way which allows you to easily identify your mistakes and bad habits. And they&#x27;ll also be some epic footage of you shredding to take home!</span><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>Don&#x27;t miss out! Give us a call or fill out the form below to lock in your spot!</span></span></p><div class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="4k7hi" id="viewer-4k7hi" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><strong style="font-weight:700"><span>FIJI BEACHOUSE</span></strong><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="d0pt3" id="viewer-d0pt3" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>
</span><span>We are your warm bed, cold beer, morning chat, and new Fiji friends on this great adventure of yours.</span></span></p><div class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="8udhr" id="viewer-8udhr" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><br role="presentation"/></span></div><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="6bla4" id="viewer-6bla4" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>The Fiji Beachouse is an intimate, family operated resort on the Coral Coast of Viti Levu. They have an awesome ethical boutique store, working space and premier surf school.</span></span></p><div class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="8i2s8" id="viewer-8i2s8" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><br role="presentation"/></span></div><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="3mvud" id="viewer-3mvud" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>They aim to deliver the best possible experience for each and every one of you. From the shores, you can kite, surf, swim, snorkel, dive, kayak and paddle board.</span><span>
</span><span>
